i) We propose an approach that jointly extracts entity mentions and semantic relations among them, using Markov Logic Network (MLN) inference.

i) joint inference over MLN improves end-to-end relation extractions, ii) local entity classifier performs better than local relation classifier and the “pipeline” relation classifiers and iii) the “pipeline” classifiers performs better than local classifiers.

1) Joint inference in MLNs can improve the performance of relation extraction by reducing the inconsistencies between the local predictions of the entity and relation classifiers, 2) Our end-to-end approach of relation extraction outperforms the previous state-of-the-art methods on the ACE 4 dataset.

the following questions: i) How to learn classifiers for simultaneous extraction of entities and relations in a text?

two aspects of end-to-end joint entity and relation extraction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

our approach of using MLNs for joint extraction of entities and relations in a single pass outperforms the baseline of individual classifiers, and also performs better than 2 previous results on the ACE 04 dataset.
we present a new end-to-end relation extractor using MLNs which outperforms all the baselines and is competitive with the state of the art.
the proposed method of using MLN for joint entity and relation extraction is a promising approach and can be extended to other NLP tasks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our approach is able to extract 80.6% of the correct relations and 90.6% of correct entity mentions in a sentence.
our approach of using inference in MLNs to jointly extract entity mentions and relations outperforms individual classifiers for both tasks.
we have proposed an approach of joint inference in MLNs for end-to-end relation recognition, which outperforms the previous results reported on ACE 2004.
The main takeaway from our work is that
joint inference in MLNs can be used to address inconsistencies between local classifiers.
joint inference in an MLN can be used as an effective framework for end-to-end relation recognition and extraction.
joint inference over MLN can help to improve the performance of relation extraction.
